notes: Fixed Motor Lock and Optic Zero unique weapons being mistaken for same-named Quickhacks.
Quickhack migration now refuses unique-folder/unique-flagged items even when their names match canonical Quickhacks.
The -Other folder itself is now authoritative for unique weapon migration; it no longer has to be nested under Do these.
Unique migration clears stale Quickhack flags/price data and runs after Quickhack migration so the unique weapon identity wins.
ADK hot reload now explicitly rerenders unique item sheets and the Items sidebar, so normal updates should not require a browser page reload.
Startup info-toast spam is suppressed during module initialization; warnings/errors still show and a single final build-loaded toast remains.
Unique weapon catalog is now 1.0.1 and Quickhack catalog is now 4.3.1.
